name: CBAM 대상 제품의 수입 여부 확인 안내 자료
official: Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism: Do you import any of these products into the EU?
remark: 자료는 한 해 수입량이 50톤 이상(>= 50)인지를 묻지만, CBAM 규정 제2a조는 한 해 순중량이 50톤을 넘지 않으면 의무를 면제한다고 정합니다. 자료의 각주에 따르면 CBAM 신청 참조번호를 세관 신고에 쓰는 것은 2026년 3월 31일까지 낸 신청에 해당합니다. 도안으로 된 자료여서 글의 차례가 원문과 다를 수 있습니다. 원문 PDF와 함께 보아 주십시오.

parts.label: 본문
blocks: Do you import any of these products into the EU?
Are your cumulative imports >= 50 tonnes annually[1]?
Are you based in the EU?
You are exempted and do not have to apply for CBAM authorisation. Imports will be monitored against the 50 tonnes threshold.
Do you have a CBAM account number or CBAM application reference number?
An indirect customs representative with CBAM authorisation can take over your CBAM obligations.
Continue importing and monitor your embedded emissions.

Submit your application to your national competent authority to obtain a CBAM application reference number[2]. This number can be used on your customs declaration until you receive a CBAM account number. Apply now to keep goods flowing smoothly across the EU border.

The Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) is the EU’s tool to put a fair price on carbon emitted during the production of carbon-intensive goods that are entering the EU, and to encourage cleaner industrial production in non-EU countries. Find out more.
[1] with the exception of electricity and hydrogen
[2] valid for applications submitted until 31 March 2026
